kipping_pull_up.name: Early pull / panic pull
kipping_pull_up.looks_like: Elbows bend while the body is still in the arch or swinging forward; chin is yanked at the bar with the hips still behind or under it.
root_causes: impatience / fear of missing the bar
kipping habit learned without a swing rhythm
kipping_pull_up.downstream_effect: Kills momentum, turns the kip into a hard strict rep, extra shoulder load, early fatigue.
kipping_pull_up.signal: Elbow angle onset of flexion (first frame elbow < 150 deg) vs hip timing. Fault if elbow flexion starts before the hip angle has closed from its arch maximum (hip still extended past ~180 deg) or before the hips reach their most forward x relative to the wrist (bar) line. Wrist x/y is the bar proxy.

threshold.value: elbow < 150 deg while hip angle >= 175 deg (still in arch) or >100 ms before hip forward-x peak
threshold.source: heuristic starting point (no published threshold found; tune on eval set)

cues: Wait for the hollow, then pull
Snap the hips before you bend
Straight arms until the hips fire
Let the swing lift you, then pull
why: The pull should start at the weightless moment at the front of the swing; pulling earlier means the arms lift dead weight.
Hip snap transfers swing energy upward; bent arms early cut that chain.
drills: Straight-arm kip swings with a hip snap (no pull)
Kipping knee raise / kip to hollow, then add pull
Kip swing + hip pop to the bar with straight arms

kipping_pull_up.name: Bent arms during the kip swing
kipping_pull_up.looks_like: Elbows stay flexed through the arch and hollow, body hangs close under the bar with a shallow swing.
root_causes: trying to stay close to the bar
kipping_pull_up.downstream_effect: Shortens the pendulum, smaller swing, less height for the pull; tires the arms.
kipping_pull_up.signal: Elbow angle (shoulder-elbow-wrist) during the swing frames before the pull window (from start until hip forward-x peak).

threshold.value: min elbow angle < 160 deg during swing
threshold.source: L3 study guide names the fault; numeric value is heuristic starting point (no published threshold found; tune on eval set)

cues: Lock the elbows, swing from the shoulders
Push the bar away as you swing
Arms are ropes until the pull
why: The swing is driven from the shoulders and hips; straight arms keep the lever long so the swing stores more energy.
drills: Beat swing holding arch/hollow for 5 rocks

kipping_pull_up.name: Bent knees / crazy legs
kipping_pull_up.looks_like: Knees bend and kick during the swing, feet separate or pedal.
root_causes: using the legs to generate swing instead of the hips/shoulders
kipping_pull_up.downstream_effect: Breaks the rigid lower-body lever, leaks energy, inconsistent swing, harder pull.
kipping_pull_up.signal: Knee angle (hip-knee-ankle) through swing and pull. Kipping is expected to show some knee motion (WKU: kipping produced greater knee angle change than strict), so flag only large flexion.

threshold.value: knee angle < 140 deg (>40 deg flexion) at any frame of the swing
threshold.source: WKU study reports peak knee angle 56.5 +/- 11.3 deg in kipping (definition ambiguous in abstract); cut-off is heuristic starting point (no published threshold found; tune on eval set)

cues: Point the toes, lock the knees
One long line, hip to toe
why: Bending the knees breaks the rigid lower-body lever and loses kinetic energy (L1).
drills: Kip swings squeezing a towel or foam block between the knees
Floor hollow/arch rocks with locked knees

kipping_pull_up.name: Leg-driven kick / Tarzan swing
kipping_pull_up.looks_like: Big knee drive or leg throw starts the swing; hips stay passive; swing is loose and uneven.
root_causes: misunderstanding where the kip comes from
no lat push-down on the bar
kipping_pull_up.downstream_effect: Uncontrolled swing amplitude, poor timing, inconsistent reps.
kipping_pull_up.signal: Ratio of knee angular velocity to hip angular velocity during the swing; plus swing amplitude (max ankle x excursion either side of bar) relative to shoulder-ankle length.

threshold.value: peak knee angular velocity > 2x peak hip angular velocity, or knee flexion > 40 deg while hip angle change < 25 deg
threshold.source: WKU average hip 76.8 deg/s, knee 127.2 deg/s in kipping (so knee > hip is normal); ratio cut-off is heuristic starting point (no published threshold found; tune on eval set)

cues: Swing from the shoulders, not the legs
Push the bar down with your lats
Drive with the hips, not the knees
why: The swing must be driven from the shoulders and hips; leg kicks add noise and break timing.
drills: Crescendo kip swing: grow amplitude while staying tight

kipping_pull_up.name: No hip pop / static hollow
kipping_pull_up.looks_like: Athlete holds one hollow shape through the whole rep; hips never snap open-to-closed; pull is all arms.
kipping_pull_up.downstream_effect: Arms do all the work; harder rep; early fatigue.
kipping_pull_up.signal: Hip angle (shoulder-hip-knee) range across the rep and peak hip angular velocity around the pull.

threshold.value: hip angle excursion < 30 deg across swing+pull, or peak hip angular velocity < 150 deg/s
threshold.source: WKU reports greater hip ROM in kipping (24.2 +/- 3.5 cm hip displacement, 48.8 +/- 6.8 deg peak hip angle); cut-offs are heuristic starting point (no published threshold found; tune on eval set)

cues: Pop the hips to the bar
why: Opening then closing the hip accelerates the body upward so the arms finish the job instead of starting it.
drills: Straight-arm hip pops from the hang
Kip swing to kipping knee raise

kipping_pull_up.name: Shallow arch / no back swing
kipping_pull_up.looks_like: Chest never passes in front of the bar and feet never travel behind it; tiny swing.
root_causes: missing the arch focus in anticipation of the pull
kipping_pull_up.downstream_effect: Not enough stored energy for the hollow; pull starts from a dead position.
kipping_pull_up.signal: Max horizontal displacement of ankle behind the wrist vertical and of shoulder/chest in front of it during the arch, normalised by shoulder-ankle length (L_body).

threshold.value: ankle behind bar < 0.15 L_body and shoulder in front of bar < 0.05 L_body
threshold.source: heuristic starting point (no published threshold found; tune on eval set)

cues: Push your chest through your arms
why: The arch is the load phase; without it the hollow has nothing to release.

kipping_pull_up.name: Broken hollow (pike or banana)
kipping_pull_up.looks_like: Hips pike sharply forward or the body bows loose in the hollow; legs swing up independent of the trunk.
kipping_pull_up.downstream_effect: Loses the rigid pendulum; energy leaks and timing drifts.
kipping_pull_up.signal: Hip angle during the hollow phase (after swing reversal, before pull). Hollow is a mild hip flexion; a sharp pike shows as a much smaller angle.

threshold.value: hip angle < 130 deg during hollow before the pull starts
threshold.source: fault named in L3 study guide; value heuristic starting point (no published threshold found; tune on eval set)

why: A rigid hollow keeps the body one pendulum so the swing energy goes upward.

kipping_pull_up.name: No push-away / dead drop
kipping_pull_up.looks_like: After the top the athlete drops straight down under the bar instead of pushing back into the arch.
root_causes: not pushing away from the bar
not strong enough for the push-away (CFHQ)
kipping_pull_up.downstream_effect: Loses the swing for the next rep; hard on shoulders at the bottom.
kipping_pull_up.signal: After peak height: shoulder x travel away from the bar line (should move behind/away) vs vertical drop. Needs frames after the top of the rep.

threshold.value: shoulder horizontal travel away from bar < 0.05 L_body while dropping > 0.2 L_body
threshold.source: heuristic starting point (no published threshold found; tune on eval set)

cues: Push the bar away at the top
Throw yourself back to the arch
why: The push-away guides the body back into the next swing so momentum carries over.
drills: Kip pull-up singles focusing on push-away into arch
Kip to push-away without pulling high
kipping_pull_up.notes: CFHQ coach: push-away is only for athletes already clearing the bar; low priority for single-rep app.

kipping_pull_up.name: Chin not over the bar (short top)
kipping_pull_up.looks_like: Peak height leaves the chin at or below bar level; head tilts back to reach.
root_causes: poor timing so the swing does not lift
kipping_pull_up.downstream_effect: No-rep under standards; reinforces short range.
kipping_pull_up.signal: At peak (max shoulder height), compare nose/chin keypoint y to wrist y (bar proxy). Nose is ~5-8 cm above chin; require nose clearly above bar.

threshold.value: nose y must be > wrist y + 5 cm (chin passes horizontal plane of bar)
threshold.source: standard from CrossFit Open 2018.5 (chin over horizontal plane of bar); 5 cm margin is heuristic starting point (no published threshold found; tune on eval set)

cues: Chin over, eyes over the bar
Pull the bar to your throat
why: The standard is chin past the bar's horizontal plane; reps that miss do not count.

kipping_pull_up.name: Chest not to bar (C2B)
kipping_pull_up.looks_like: On chest-to-bar reps the chest stops short of the bar or contacts above the collarbone.
kipping_pull_up.signal: At peak, shoulder keypoint y vs wrist y and horizontal distance shoulder-to-wrist. Contact below collarbone means shoulders roughly at bar height and close to it.

threshold.value: shoulder y >= wrist y - 8 cm and shoulder-wrist horizontal distance < 15 cm
threshold.source: standard (contact below collarbone) from CrossFit 2019 OQ; numeric proxy heuristic starting point (no published threshold found; tune on eval set)

cues: Pull the bar to your chest
Lean back, pull to the sternum
why: Contact below the collarbone needs the shoulders to rise to the bar and the elbows to go behind the torso.
drills: Break sets early (about 1/3 of max per set)

kipping_pull_up.name: No full arm extension at the bottom
kipping_pull_up.looks_like: Rep starts or re-starts with elbows bent.
kipping_pull_up.signal: Max elbow angle in the bottom hang phase (start of clip or between reps).

threshold.value: elbow < 160 deg at start (standard: arms fully extended; 10 deg allowance for keypoint error)
threshold.source: standard from CrossFit Open 2018.5; tolerance heuristic starting point (no published threshold found; tune on eval set)

cues: Lock the arms at the bottom
why: Standards require full extension; a bent-arm start also shortens the swing.
drills: Single kip reps from full hang

kipping_pull_up.name: Shrugged, passive shoulders at bottom of swing
kipping_pull_up.looks_like: Shoulders up by the ears in the hang/swing; body sinks into end range.
kipping_pull_up.downstream_effect: Shoulder joint takes force passively; linked with shoulder irritation.
kipping_pull_up.signal: Shoulder-to-wrist distance vs arm length (shoulder-elbow + elbow-wrist) and ear-to-shoulder distance at the bottom of the swing. Passive hang = shoulder-wrist distance near maximal and ear-shoulder distance small.

threshold.value: ear-shoulder distance < 0.35 x upper-arm length at swing bottom
threshold.source: heuristic starting point (no published threshold found; tune on eval set); noisy under 5 cm error

cues: Push the bar toward your hips
why: An active shoulder keeps force in the muscles instead of passive shoulder structures.

kipping_pull_up.name: Late pull (after the swing peaks)
kipping_pull_up.looks_like: Athlete waits too long, the body has started swinging back under the bar before the elbows bend.
kipping_pull_up.downstream_effect: Pulling against backward momentum; rep stalls.
kipping_pull_up.signal: Elbow flexion onset relative to the hips' forward-x peak (front of swing). Late if elbow flexion begins after hips have started moving back toward/behind the bar.

threshold.value: elbow flexion onset > 150 ms after hip forward-x peak
threshold.source: heuristic starting point (no published threshold found; tune on eval set)

cues: Pull at the top of the hollow
why: The pull window is short: the weightless moment at the front of the swing.
drills: Kip to hollow with a pause cue

kipping_pull_up.name: Chin reach / neck crane
kipping_pull_up.looks_like: Athlete throws the head back to get the chin over while shoulders stay well below the bar.
kipping_pull_up.downstream_effect: Neck strain; masks a short pull.
kipping_pull_up.signal: At peak: nose above wrist line but shoulder y far below wrist y; head tilt (ear-nose vector) strongly upward.

threshold.value: nose over bar while shoulder y < wrist y - 0.6 x upper-arm length
threshold.source: heuristic starting point (no published threshold found; tune on eval set)

cues: Chest to the bar, not chin
why: Craning hides a short pull; get the shoulders higher instead.
kipping_pull_up.notes: Derived fault; not named by a fetched source (unverified).

kipping_pull_up.name: Butterfly: legs under/behind at bar contact
kipping_pull_up.looks_like: Chest meets the bar with the legs already bent underneath or behind; athlete feels they will hit their face.
root_causes: kipping habit carried over (same end position)
kipping_pull_up.signal: At peak height: ankle x relative to the bar vertical (wrist x). Correct: feet in front of the bar's vertical plane. Also knee angle at peak.

threshold.value: ankle x behind wrist x at peak shoulder height
threshold.source: WODprep butterfly article (feet in front of bar plane); sign test only

cues: Feet in front of the bar
why: Driving toes forward and shoulders back moves the body around the bar so the face clears it.
drills: Reverse bicycle kicks with one foot on a box

kipping_pull_up.name: Butterfly: short scoop / arm-dominant
kipping_pull_up.looks_like: Leg and hip swing cut short; arms do most of the work; rhythm feels hard.
kipping_pull_up.downstream_effect: Fatigues fast; reps feel harder than they should.
kipping_pull_up.signal: Ankle path loop size (vertical + horizontal extent of the ankle trajectory per cycle) and hip angle range per cycle; elbow flexion that precedes the scoop.

threshold.value: ankle trajectory height < 0.3 L_body per cycle or hip angle range < 40 deg
threshold.source: heuristic starting point (no published threshold found; tune on eval set)

cues: Hips and legs do the work
why: The butterfly is driven by a full hip-and-leg swing; cutting it short removes the power.

kipping_pull_up.name: Butterfly/C2B: weak back swing
kipping_pull_up.looks_like: No aggressive swing behind the bar; contact happens late on the way up.
kipping_pull_up.downstream_effect: Misses the chest target; slower cycle.
kipping_pull_up.signal: Max ankle displacement behind the wrist line during the cycle.

threshold.value: ankle behind bar < 0.15 L_body
threshold.source: heuristic starting point (no published threshold found; tune on eval set)

cues: Brush the bar at the top
why: CrossFit coaches cue an aggressive back swing with the bar brushed at the apex or on the descent.

bar_muscle_up.name: Early arm pull (pulling into the bar)
bar_muscle_up.looks_like: Elbows bend early like a chest-to-bar pull-up; athlete pulls into the bar instead of levering around it.
bar_muscle_up.downstream_effect: Body ends up under the bar with no room to turn over; failed transition.
bar_muscle_up.signal: Elbow angle during the pull relative to hip height. Straight-arm lever expected until hips approach bar height.

threshold.value: elbow < 150 deg while hip y is still > 0.25 L_body below wrist y
threshold.source: heuristic starting point (no published threshold found; tune on eval set)

cues: Straight arms, pull the bar to your hips
Pull around the bar, not to it
Push the bar down to your hips
Arms long until the hips arrive
why: Straight-arm pulling moves the hips and shoulders behind the bar, creating room for the turnover.
drills: Pull to stomp (straight-arm pull to box)

bar_muscle_up.name: No hip pop / hips not to the bar
bar_muscle_up.looks_like: Big kip but the hips never drive up to bar height.
bar_muscle_up.downstream_effect: Not enough height to transition; athlete muscles it or misses.
bar_muscle_up.signal: Peak hip y relative to wrist y (bar) during the pull.

threshold.value: peak hip y below wrist y by > 0.15 L_body
threshold.source: heuristic starting point (no published threshold found; tune on eval set)

why: Hip extension supplies the upward speed that lets the hands turn over the bar.

bar_muscle_up.name: Chicken wing (one arm over first)
bar_muscle_up.looks_like: One elbow/shoulder clears the bar before the other; that arm pries the other over.
root_causes: feet split in the kip rotating the torso
bar_muscle_up.downstream_effect: Inefficient, fatiguing, possible shoulder injury; failed reps.
bar_muscle_up.signal: Side-on the far arm is often occluded. Use left vs right elbow and wrist keypoint height difference during turnover, plus apparent shoulder width change (torso rotation) and hip-shoulder twist.

threshold.value: left-right elbow y difference > 12 cm during turnover, or apparent shoulder width > 2x baseline
threshold.source: heuristic starting point (no published threshold found; tune on eval set); low confidence side-on

why: An uneven turnover puts one shoulder in a bad position and makes the press much harder.
drills: Kip swings squeezing a sponge between the feet

bar_muscle_up.name: Feet split / scissor kick in the kip
bar_muscle_up.looks_like: Legs separate front-back during the swing.
bar_muscle_up.downstream_effect: Torso rotates; leads to chicken wing.
bar_muscle_up.signal: Horizontal separation of left vs right ankle (and knee) keypoints in the swing; side-on scissoring shows clearly, side-by-side split does not.

threshold.value: ankle x separation > 15 cm during swing
threshold.source: heuristic starting point (no published threshold found; tune on eval set)

cues: Squeeze a sponge with your feet
why: Separate feet twist the torso, which rotates the turnover.

bar_muscle_up.name: Bent arms in the kip swing
bar_muscle_up.looks_like: Elbows flex during the arch/hollow before the pull.
bar_muscle_up.signal: Min elbow angle during swing frames.

threshold.value: elbow < 160 deg before pull window
threshold.source: heuristic starting point (no published threshold found; tune on eval set)

why: Straight arms keep the pendulum long so the kip stores more energy.

bar_muscle_up.name: Bent knees in the swing
bar_muscle_up.looks_like: Knees bend as the swing grows.

threshold.value: knee angle < 150 deg during beat/kip swing
threshold.source: heuristic starting point (no published threshold found; tune on eval set)

cues: No knee bend in the swing
Swing from the hips, not knees
why: Ganbaru: there is no room for a knee bend in a beat swing.

bar_muscle_up.name: Loose / Tarzan kip
bar_muscle_up.looks_like: Large sloppy swings; shapes on the bar don't resemble the hollow and arch.
bar_muscle_up.signal: Swing amplitude (ankle x excursion) relative to hip angle change; large amplitude with small hip-angle change and large knee change signals a loose swing.

threshold.value: ankle excursion > 0.8 L_body with hip angle change < 30 deg
threshold.source: heuristic starting point (no published threshold found; tune on eval set)

why: Controlled shapes transmit force; a loose swing only looks big.

bar_muscle_up.name: Low back swing / weak arch
bar_muscle_up.looks_like: Feet barely travel behind the bar in the arch.
bar_muscle_up.downstream_effect: Insufficient height, compensations like the chicken wing.
bar_muscle_up.signal: Max ankle displacement behind wrist line, normalised by L_body.

threshold.value: ankle behind bar < 0.2 L_body
threshold.source: heuristic starting point (no published threshold found; tune on eval set)

why: Back-swing height feeds the hollow and hip drive.

bar_muscle_up.name: Rushing out of the arch
bar_muscle_up.looks_like: Athlete reverses from arch to hollow before the swing reaches its back peak.
bar_muscle_up.signal: Time of hip angle reversal (arch max -> closing) vs time of ankle peak behind the bar.

threshold.value: hip closing starts > 100 ms before ankle back-x peak
threshold.source: heuristic starting point (no published threshold found; tune on eval set)

why: Momentum should dictate the change; early reversal throws the stored energy away.

bar_muscle_up.name: Toes don't reach chest height
bar_muscle_up.looks_like: In the hollow/reversal the toes stay low, so the hips can't drive toward the bar.
root_causes: no knee/toe lift before hip drive
bar_muscle_up.downstream_effect: No room to open the hips into the bar.
bar_muscle_up.signal: Peak ankle y relative to shoulder/chest y in the hollow before hip extension; or minimum hip angle.

threshold.value: peak ankle y below hip y, or min hip angle > 110 deg before hip extension
threshold.source: Ganbaru: toes should reach chest height; numeric proxy heuristic starting point (no published threshold found; tune on eval set)

cues: Toes to the ceiling, then hips
Lift the legs before the pop
why: Raising the toes first loads the hip so its extension drives the body up to the bar.

bar_muscle_up.name: Incomplete hip extension at the drive
bar_muscle_up.looks_like: Hips don't open fully toward the bar before the turnover.
bar_muscle_up.signal: Max hip angle during the drive window (after toes peak, before shoulders pass bar).

threshold.value: max hip angle < 160 deg during drive
threshold.source: heuristic starting point (no published threshold found; tune on eval set)

why: Full hip extension adds the last upward speed.

bar_muscle_up.name: Slow, unaggressive transition
bar_muscle_up.looks_like: Athlete gets to the bar but stalls before the shoulders roll over; drifts and sinks.
bar_muscle_up.downstream_effect: Stalls at the hardest point; missed reps.
bar_muscle_up.signal: Time from hip peak height (or max elbow flexion near bar) to shoulders crossing in front of the wrist line.

threshold.value: > 0.35 s from hip peak to shoulder x passing wrist x
threshold.source: heuristic starting point (no published threshold found; tune on eval set)

why: The turnover must be quick while the body is still weightless at the top.
drills: Banded BMU as a tactile cue

bar_muscle_up.name: Transition attempted too low
bar_muscle_up.looks_like: Athlete tries to turn over with the bar still around the chest or higher.
bar_muscle_up.downstream_effect: Grinds or fails into the dip.
bar_muscle_up.signal: At the start of forward torso rotation (shoulders moving over wrist x), compare wrist y to torso: bar should be near the lower ribs/hips.

threshold.value: wrist y above (shoulder y - 0.4 x shoulder-hip length) at turnover start
threshold.source: L3 names incomplete pull; numeric proxy heuristic starting point (no published threshold found; tune on eval set)

cues: Pull the bar to your hips
Get the bar to your belly
why: The bar should meet the stomach/hip area so the shoulders can move forward over it.

bar_muscle_up.name: Catching low / deep dip
bar_muscle_up.looks_like: After the turnover the athlete sinks into a deep dip below the bar before pressing.
root_causes: losing downward pressure on the bar
bar_muscle_up.signal: Minimum elbow angle after shoulders pass over the bar and shoulder y vs wrist y in the dip.

threshold.value: min elbow angle < 70 deg after turnover, or shoulder y below wrist y
threshold.source: heuristic starting point (no published threshold found; tune on eval set)

cues: Push the bar away the whole time
Stay on top of the bar
why: Constant pressure into the bar keeps the catch high so the press is short.

bar_muscle_up.name: No lockout / shoulders behind bar at top
bar_muscle_up.looks_like: Rep finishes with elbows soft or shoulders behind the bar.
bar_muscle_up.signal: Max elbow angle at top and shoulder x vs wrist x (shoulders must be over or in front of bar when viewed from side).

threshold.value: elbow < 165 deg (allow 10 deg error -> flag < 160) or shoulder x behind wrist x by > 5 cm
threshold.source: CrossFit 2025 Open standard (arms fully extended, shoulders over or slightly in front of bar viewed from side); tolerances heuristic starting point (no published threshold found; tune on eval set)

why: The rep only counts at full lockout with shoulders over the bar.

bar_muscle_up.name: Feet above the bar during kip
bar_muscle_up.looks_like: Feet rise above the bar during the kip (no-rep in Open standard).
bar_muscle_up.signal: Any frame where an ankle/foot keypoint y exceeds wrist y.

threshold.value: ankle y > wrist y
threshold.source: CrossFit 2025 Open no-rep list

cues: Toes to chest, not over the bar
Keep the feet below the bar
why: Feet above the bar is a no-rep and wastes the kip.

bar_muscle_up.name: No full hang at start
bar_muscle_up.signal: Elbow angle at start of rep.

threshold.value: elbow < 160 deg at start
threshold.source: standard (full extension from hang); tolerance heuristic starting point (no published threshold found; tune on eval set)

why: Standard requires a full hang; it also makes the kip longer.

kipping_hspu.name: Incomplete lockout (arms)
kipping_hspu.looks_like: Rep ends with soft elbows at the top.
kipping_hspu.signal: Max elbow angle at the top of the rep (body inverted, so shoulder-elbow-wrist below head).

threshold.value: elbow < 165 deg at top (flag < 160 with 10 deg error)
threshold.source: standard (arms fully extended) CrossFit 2024 QF/2020 Open; tolerance heuristic starting point (no published threshold found; tune on eval set)

cues: Lock the elbows at the top
Press until the arms are straight
why: Arms locked with hips open is the finish standard; pushing the head through adds lockout power.

kipping_hspu.name: Hips not extended at the top (piked finish)
kipping_hspu.looks_like: Finishes with hips bent, butt on the wall, only feet high.
kipping_hspu.downstream_effect: No-rep; heels may miss the wall.
kipping_hspu.signal: Hip angle (shoulder-hip-knee) and knee angle at top.

threshold.value: hip angle < 160 deg or knee angle < 160 deg at top
threshold.source: standard (hips open, body in line with arms); tolerance heuristic starting point (no published threshold found; tune on eval set)

cues: Open the hips at the top
why: Rep finish needs arms locked and hips open.
drills: Wall handstand holds with glutes squeezed

kipping_hspu.name: No eccentric control / crashing onto head
kipping_hspu.looks_like: Head drops fast into the floor; descent is a controlled fall.
kipping_hspu.downstream_effect: Neck loading; the most dangerous HSPU fault per L3; preprint found head forces above bodyweight.
kipping_hspu.signal: Descent duration (top lockout to head-floor contact) and head/shoulder vertical velocity just before contact. Floor plane = wrist y.

threshold.value: descent < 0.35 s or head vertical speed > 1.0 m/s in the last 5 cm
threshold.source: heuristic starting point (no published threshold found; tune on eval set); Bove 2023 preprint: peak head force during kip usually > 1x bodyweight (403 on full text, abstract only)

why: Crashing dumps load on the neck; controlled lowering keeps the arms carrying the weight.

kipping_hspu.name: Head doesn't reach the floor/target
kipping_hspu.looks_like: Athlete turns around before the head touches.
kipping_hspu.signal: Lowest head keypoint (nose/ear, offset to head top) vs floor (wrist y). COCO has no head-top keypoint so add an offset of ~10-12 cm from ear.

threshold.value: estimated head-top > 3 cm above wrist y at bottom
threshold.source: standard (head contacts floor/target); margin heuristic starting point (no published threshold found; tune on eval set)

cues: Head to the floor every rep
why: Head contact is required for the rep.
drills: Ab-mat scaled HSPU removing mats over time

kipping_hspu.name: Press before the kip (arms before legs)
kipping_hspu.looks_like: Elbows start extending before the hips/knees snap open; kip is wasted.
kipping_hspu.downstream_effect: Arms do the work; stall mid-press.
kipping_hspu.signal: Onset of elbow extension vs onset of knee/hip extension from the tuck. Kipping HSPU is an inverted push press: legs drive, arms follow.

threshold.value: elbow extension onset > 80 ms before knee extension onset
threshold.source: heuristic starting point (no published threshold found; tune on eval set)

cues: Snap the legs, then lock out
why: Closing then opening the hip creates momentum that assists the press; pressing first loses it.
drills: Kip-only reps (kick to headstand, no press)

kipping_hspu.name: Press too late (legs fire, arms wait)
kipping_hspu.looks_like: Legs kick up, body rises slightly, then arms start pressing after momentum has gone.
kipping_hspu.downstream_effect: Momentum lost; grinding press or fall-off.
kipping_hspu.signal: Gap between peak knee/hip extension velocity and elbow extension onset.

threshold.value: elbow extension onset > 200 ms after peak knee extension velocity
threshold.source: heuristic starting point (no published threshold found; tune on eval set)

cues: Punch the floor as you kick
why: The arms must catch the lift the legs create, like a push press drive.
drills: Kipping HSPU singles with a press-on-kick cue

kipping_hspu.name: Shallow tuck / weak kip
kipping_hspu.looks_like: Knees barely come down, so the kick is small.
kipping_hspu.downstream_effect: Can't get out of the bottom.
kipping_hspu.signal: Minimum hip angle and knee angle in the bottom tuck; knee y relative to hip y.

threshold.value: min hip angle > 100 deg (knees not dropped toward parallel)
threshold.source: WODprep: let knees drop below parallel when fatigued; numeric proxy heuristic starting point (no published threshold found; tune on eval set)

why: A deeper tuck lengthens the kick so the legs provide more lift.

kipping_hspu.name: Hands too close to the wall
kipping_hspu.looks_like: Butt hits the wall during hip extension and bucks the athlete off.
kipping_hspu.downstream_effect: Lost balance; heels may come off the wall.
kipping_hspu.signal: Wall usually not keypointed. Proxy: at the bottom, hip x passes beyond the wrist line on the wall side by a large margin, then is pushed back abruptly during the kick (hip x velocity reversal).

threshold.value: hip x beyond wrist x by > 0.35 L_body at bottom with abrupt reversal
threshold.source: WODprep: hands about a hand and a half from the wall; ~12 in for kipping vs ~6 in strict (search snippet); proxy heuristic starting point (no published threshold found; tune on eval set)

cues: Set up a hand and a half out
why: The hips need room to open; too close and the wall pushes you off.
drills: Experiment with hand distance, mark a line

kipping_hspu.name: Hands too far from the wall / body not vertical
kipping_hspu.looks_like: Body leans away from vertical; awkward lockout; falling into the wall.
kipping_hspu.signal: Angle of the wrist-to-ankle (or shoulder-ankle) line from vertical at lockout.

threshold.value: body line > 15 deg from vertical at lockout
threshold.source: heuristic starting point (no published threshold found; tune on eval set)

why: A vertical stack lets the arms press straight up.
drills: Wall handstand holds with hand marks

kipping_hspu.name: Kick misses / heels off the wall
kipping_hspu.looks_like: Kick goes straight up or away; heels don't stick to the wall at the top.
kipping_hspu.downstream_effect: No-rep (heels must touch wall at start/end).
kipping_hspu.signal: Ankle x trajectory: at top the ankles should return to the wall-side extreme seen at the start lockout. Flag if final ankle x is short of the start lockout ankle x.

threshold.value: top ankle x short of start-lockout ankle x by > 8 cm
threshold.source: heuristic starting point (no published threshold found; tune on eval set)

cues: Heels to where wall meets ceiling
Drive the heels up and back
Kick to the wall, not up
why: Driving heels toward the wall-ceiling corner makes them shoot back and stick; feet not touching wall is a common no-rep.
kipping_hspu.notes: Invictus cue taken from a search snippet; page fetched only the homepage (unverified).

kipping_hspu.name: Arched lockout / lumbar hyperextension
kipping_hspu.looks_like: Lower back over-arched at the top, belly toward the wall, abs off.
root_causes: kicking up with back to wall
kipping_hspu.signal: Shoulder-hip-ankle angle at lockout (deviation of hip from the shoulder-ankle line, toward the front/away from wall).

threshold.value: shoulder-hip-ankle angle < 165 deg with hip displaced away from the wall
threshold.source: heuristic starting point (no published threshold found; tune on eval set)

why: An arched lockout is not a strong position; a straight line stacks the joints.

kipping_hspu.name: Neck extension at the bottom / kip
kipping_hspu.looks_like: Athlete cranes the neck (head tilts back) while on the head during the kip.
kipping_hspu.downstream_effect: Preprint: participants reporting pain after kipping HSPUs moved their head into extension.
kipping_hspu.signal: Head pitch from ear-nose vector relative to the torso (shoulder-hip) line during the bottom phase. Upside-down face keypoints are less reliable.

threshold.value: head pitch > 25 deg extension relative to torso during head contact
threshold.source: heuristic starting point (no published threshold found; tune on eval set); Bove 2023 preprint (abstract) links extension with pain

why: Head extension under load is linked with pain reports after kipping HSPUs.

kipping_hspu.name: Head placement off (tripod lost)
kipping_hspu.looks_like: Head lands in line with or behind the hands instead of forming a tripod in front of them; or tripod collapses partway.
kipping_hspu.signal: Horizontal offset of the head (ear/nose) from the wrist x at bottom, normalised by forearm length.

threshold.value: head offset outside 0.3-1.0 x forearm length in front of the wrists
threshold.source: heuristic starting point (no published threshold found; tune on eval set)

cues: Make a triangle with your head
Head slightly in front of the hands
Land head in front of hands
why: The tripod (two hands + head) is the base; many athletes lose it mid-set.
kipping_hspu.notes: Sources conflict: Nike/CrossFit coaches cue a tripod for kipping; strict-HSPU sources cue head between hands. Treat as movement-variant dependent.

kipping_hspu.name: Resting on the head (strict: dead stop)
kipping_hspu.looks_like: Pause on the head with tension lost; press out of a dead stop.
kipping_hspu.downstream_effect: Hard to press out; slower sets. (Allowed to relax in kipping per WODprep, fault for strict.)
kipping_hspu.signal: Time the head stays at its minimum height (velocity ~0) before pressing.

threshold.value: > 0.5 s stationary at bottom on strict reps
threshold.source: heuristic starting point (no published threshold found; tune on eval set)

why: Losing shoulder and chest tension makes the press from a dead stop much harder.

kipping_hspu.name: Head drops / no 'head through' at lockout
kipping_hspu.looks_like: Head stays tucked or looks down at the floor at the top; awkward lockout.
kipping_hspu.signal: At the top, ear x position relative to the shoulder-wrist line (head should be between the arms).

threshold.value: ear forward of shoulder-wrist line by > 6 cm at lockout
threshold.source: heuristic starting point (no published threshold found; tune on eval set)

why: Pushing the head through stacks arms and shoulders for a stronger lockout.
drills: Wall handstand holds with head-through cue

kipping_hspu.name: Hips drift away from the wall (strict)
kipping_hspu.looks_like: Hips sag away from the wall during the press; body bends.
kipping_hspu.downstream_effect: Poor press angle; heel contact lost.
kipping_hspu.signal: Hip x movement away from the wall side during the press relative to start.

threshold.value: hip x moves > 10 cm away from wall during press
threshold.source: heuristic starting point (no published threshold found; tune on eval set)

why: Hips sagging off the wall breaks the line the press needs.

kipping_hspu.name: Start not locked out
kipping_hspu.looks_like: First rep begins from the bottom or with soft arms/heels off wall.
kipping_hspu.signal: Elbow angle and body line in the first frames of the clip.

threshold.value: elbow < 160 deg at start
threshold.source: WODprep and CrossFit standards (start locked out, heels on wall)

why: Reps begin and end locked out with heels on the wall.
drills: Kick-up to lockout hold before each set

kipping_hspu.name: Hands too wide
kipping_hspu.looks_like: Hands set wide; pressing angle wrecked.
kipping_hspu.signal: Not visible side-on (frontal plane). Would need a front view; skip.

threshold.source: none found

why: Too wide shortens ROM but wrecks the pressing angle.
drills: Wall holds with taped hand marks

kipping_hspu.name: Elbows flare (strict)

threshold.source: none found (push-up source: elbows past ~45 deg from body push the shoulder forward)

why: Flared elbows reduce shoulder space and load the elbow tendons.

conventions.bar_proxy: wrist keypoints (hands on bar); floor proxy for HSPU = wrist y
conventions.L_body: shoulder-to-ankle length measured in the hang/lockout
conventions.threshold_note: Almost no published numeric thresholds exist for these faults; values tagged heuristic are starting points to tune on the eval set. Only movement standards (CrossFit) and WKU kinematics are sourced numbers.
